name: skeleton
description: Bone layer (like Moho's bone layer): a container that holds the skeleton and the drawing that skeleton moves. Inside go, in drawing order, the shapes and groups (as in a group), and the root bones (bone), which start in its frame: moving, rotating or scaling it carries the drawing and the bones along together. The drawing inside stays still until it is bound to one of its bones (bone property, or bind_by_proximity). A skeleton can go inside another one and be bound to a bone of the outer one.
help: Bone layer, like in Moho: a container with the skeleton and the drawing it moves. Its drawing binds only to its own bones.
